residual_findings.source: dev pre-implement discovery + .mstar/AGENTS.md pre-existing claim verification
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.48 P0 T0: H-1 hotfix performed in-plan. RVM schedule_id PK collision root-caused: enqueue_review_master_schedule minted RVM<ts_ms> which collided when two opt-in Works enqueued in same millisecond. Fix: per-process RVM_COUNTER AtomicU32 appended as 6-hex suffix (mirrors ACH_COUNTER / R-V139P0-W-B). Regression test rvm_schedule_ids_are_unique_within_same_millisecond added.
